description: Conservative top-down grasp strategy for narrow upright rigid objects.

validated_scope.note: Validation scope is evidence metadata, not a global object allowlist. Upright bottle activation remains candidate-only.

provenance.intended_use: Session-local candidate strategy; not a validated task-family policy.

canary_evidence.summary: On LIBERO object task 7 seed 7, two Advisor-selected raw side-contact attempts collapsed to empty close during a 3-5 cm lift probe, while an explicitly selected top-down branch passed attachment assessment and transported the milk carton across the table. A privileged diagnostic-only physical canary then completed top-down pick, collision-checked transport, centred raised release, and official reward in 3/3 repetitions; Agent-driven end-to-end placement is not yet validated.
canary_evidence.physical_canary_scope: Privileged simulator coordinates isolate embodiment physics only; these runs do not validate Agent perception, planning, or policy.
